{"command":"create","path":"/workspace/clean_space.sh","file_text":"#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# Disk cleanup helper
# Usage:
#   clean_space.sh           # perform cleanup
#   clean_space.sh --dry-run # show what would be removed

DRY_RUN=0
if [[ "${1:-}" == "--dry-run" ]]; then
  DRY_RUN=1
fi

log() { echo "[$(date '+%F %T')] $*"; }

report_df() {
  df -h | awk 'NR==1 || NR==2 {print}'
}

delete() {
  local path="$1"
  # Expand globs explicitly to handle patterns
  shopt -s nullglob
  local matches=( $path )
  shopt -u nullglob
  for p in "${matches[@]}"; do
    if [ -e "$p" ]; then
      if [ "$DRY_RUN" -eq 1 ]; then
        local sz
        sz=$(du -shx "$p" 2>/dev/null | cut -f1 || echo "?")
        log "Would remove: $p ($sz)"
      else
        local sz
        sz=$(du -shx "$p" 2>/dev/null | cut -f1 || echo "?")
        rm -rf "$p" || true
        log "Removed: $p ($sz)"
      fi
    fi
  done
}

clean_apt() {
  if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    if [ "$DRY_RUN" -eq 1 ]; then
      log "Would run: apt-get clean"
      log "Would remove: /var/lib/apt/lists/*"
      log "Would remove: /var/cache/apt/archives/*.deb /var/cache/apt/*.bin"
    else
      apt-get clean || true
      rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* || true
      rm -rf /var/cache/apt/archives/*.deb /var/cache/apt/*.bin 2>/dev/null || true
    fi
  fi
}

clean_tmp() {
  # Remove files in /tmp older than 1 day to be conservative
  if [ "$DRY_RUN" -eq 1 ]; then
    log "Would remove files older than 1 day in /tmp"
  else
    find /tmp -mindepth 1 -mtime +1 -print -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^/[tmp] removed /' || true
  fi
}

clean_pycache() {
  # Remove __pycache__ in typical project/user paths, avoid system dirs
  local roots=( "/workspace" "/openhands" "/root" )
  for r in "${roots[@]}"; do
    if [ -d "$r" ]; then
      if [ "$DRY_RUN" -eq 1 ]; then
        find "$r" -xdev -type d -name "__pycache__" -prune -print 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^/[pycache] would remove /'
      else
        find "$r" -xdev -type d -name "__pycache__" -prune -print -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^/[pycache] removed /'
      fi
    fi
  done
}

main() {
  log "Disk usage before:"
  report_df

  log "Cleaning caches and temporary data..."

  # Common caches
  delete "/root/.cache/pip"
  delete "/root/.cache/pypoetry"
  delete "/root/.cache/ms-playwright"
  delete "/root/.cache/**/http*"

  # Temp and editor/playwright leftovers
  delete "/tmp/playwright*"
  delete "/tmp/oh_editor_history_*"
  clean_tmp

  # APT caches
  clean_apt

  # Python __pycache__ under safe roots
  clean_pycache

  log "Disk usage after:"
  report_df
  log "Cleanup complete${DRY_RUN:+ (dry-run)}."
}

main "$@"
"}
